about: LIC1 (hard rule #32). Every third-party item and every icon, glyph, image and font the app uses. Checked by tools/check-licences.mjs (run by tools/probe-data.mjs); THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md is generated from this file (node tools/check-licences.mjs --write).

policy.refused: GPL, AGPL, LGPL, MPL, any share-alike (SA), non-commercial (NC) or no-derivatives (ND) terms; anything else needs the user's decision first
